about: Hand-written notes for the gallery (ROADMAP M8.4), from the numbers printed by tools/build-gallery.mjs. Order = order shown.

stories.empty: The baseline. Nobody gets out: the snow is too deep off the paths and too deep on them. A third are caught, a third are taken by the cold, a quarter are still wandering at the end.
stories.plan-b: One plowed route from Azalea Pond to the nearest exit, three lamps, a sign. A quarter now escape. But the creature catches more than before (48 %): it learns where the route runs, and the lamps show it who is on it.
stories.plan-b-dark: The same route without its lamps, and it is better: catches fall from 48 % to 31 % and more get out. The lamps were helping the creature more than the people. The price is the cold: without light, more stop and freeze (27 %).
stories.plan-b-bright: The same route with all 12 lamps. Fewer catches than three lamps: the creature avoids light (lit cells cost it three times as much), so a fully lit corridor keeps it away, while a few lamps only mark the targets. It costs twice as much and scores lower than the dark route.
stories.lamp-corridor: Light without plowing is worse than nothing. The lamps and signs draw people onto the route, but the route is under 60 cm of snow: slow, loud and cold. The lowest warmth of any plan, and still nobody escapes.
stories.shelters: Two warming shelters where people start, nothing else. Fewest catches and the least cold of all: people get warm and stay. That is the problem: more than half are still sheltering when the round ends. Safe, and going nowhere.
stories.funnel: Plan B, plus every side path along its route closed, meant to keep people on the plowed way. It shuts them in instead: the closures also cut the ways from where people start to the route. Nobody escapes, and the creature waits at the few junctions left open.
stories.evolved-survivors: Thirty generations of the automatic mode from Plan B, scoring for the survivors. It kept the plowed route, dropped a lamp and the sign, added a shelter and closed three paths. The best score in the gallery: fewer seen, fewer cold.
stories.evolved-creature: The same search scoring for the creature. It also plows and lights a route, then adds signs and shelters along it: everything that tells people where to go, and so tells the creature where they will be. It spends the most and catches the most.
